changelog: `apm uninstall`, `apm prune` and target-removal installs list each deployed path they delete, and the cleanup count matches the listed paths (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: Uninstall, prune and target-removal cleanup deleted deployed files without naming them, and the reported count also counted skill directories alongside their members.

red: APM_BINARY_PATH=$(uv run which apm) uv run --extra dev pytest tests/integration/test_stale_cleanup_diagnostics.py -k removal_commands -n 0 -> 3 failed: AssertionError: .agents/skills/named/SKILL.md was removed but not named (uninstall: '[i] Cleaned 6 stale deployed files for ../named-kit'; prune: '[i] Cleaned 6 deployed integration file(s)'); target-removal: .claude/rules/named.md was removed but not named
green: same command -> 3 passed; module -> 7 passed; 14 cleanup/prune/uninstall integration modules -> 102 passed, 3 skipped
owner: src/apm_cli/integration/cleanup.py (CleanupResult.announced_paths: folds members into a deleted skill directory shown with a trailing '/', '~/' prefix in user scope) + src/apm_cli/core/command_logger.py (CommandLogger.stale_cleanup(dep_key, cleanup) and InstallLogger.orphan_cleanup(cleanups) render 'Cleaned N stale deployed files|paths for DEP:' then one '  - <path>' line per path). Callers routed: commands/prune.py (per pruned dependency, replaces 'Cleaned N deployed integration file(s)'), install/presentation (target contraction, used by uninstall), install/phases/cleanup.py (stale and orphan), install/phases/post_deps_local.py.
notes: Output format change: header ends with ':' and lists paths; noun is 'paths' when a directory is listed. Journey cells to update: J04 s5 key_line ('Cleaned 20 stale deployed files for vercel-labs/agent-skills' -> header with the folded count and listed skill dirs), J08 s3 key_line '[i] Cleaned 6 deployed integration file(s)' -> 'Cleaned 4 stale deployed paths for acme/live-kit:' style, and known cells uninstall-cleanup-unannounced / prune-cleanup-unannounced / install-stale-cleanup-unannounced (J09) should flip. The install summary noun ('N stale files cleaned') is unchanged, but its count is now the number of listed paths. Docs updated: reference/cli/{install,uninstall,prune}.md and apm-guide commands.md (commands.md is also touched by #4138/#4143 in other paragraphs).
